main_result_paragraphs.paragraph: Using paired target and reference measurements

images.original_seven_figures_author_review_onl: Original_Source_Figures contains all seven original figures; full review book is in Author_Review. No originals other than HE enter the main manuscript directly. They must stay excluded from submission attachments unless expressly labeled supporting provenance.

four_limitations.ROS_matrix: O12 serum kit used on RIPA tissue without matrix/buffer validation, unknown reader, no ROS absolute/species interpretation; common handling does not exclude differential matrix bias.
four_limitations.qPCR: Single target/reference measurement per rat, unvalidated efficiency and beta-actin stability, unavailable original amplification/melting curves and NTC/no-RT records.
four_limitations.timing_controls: Sham/model day28, restoration day56, no matched second-surgery sham; no independent removal benefit or reversal claim.
four_limitations.analgesia: No postoperative analgesics, unavailable written rationale/specific ethics opinion; pain/stress confounding acknowledged.

other_confirmed_disclosures.funding: Provincial Natural Science Foundation of Anhui, 1608085MH185; funder no scientific/manuscript/submission role.
other_confirmed_disclosures.AI: Actual language, organization, method checking, numerical reanalysis and conventional code assistance; exact model identifier not archived; author responsibility.
other_confirmed_disclosures.related_research: 2017 model precedent and 2026 related report cited; shared BP and inability to independently reproduce/correlate explained.
other_confirmed_disclosures.HE: No group-level inference, unknown specimen number and identity; original scale pixels retained.
other_confirmed_disclosures.hypothesis_figure: Figure4 caption explicitly identifies proposed relationships, dashed untested links and absence of pathway intervention/sympathetic recordings.

remaining_record_limitations: AI exact model version not archived; truthful limitation retained.
Corresponding addresses kept exactly as author-confirmed institution/city/postcode/email; no street invented.
Four scientific/animal-welfare limitations persist as already disclosed; reformatting does not resolve them.

final_caption_correction.caption_3_text: Fig. 3. Relative Nox1 (A) and Nox4 (B) mRNA in regional medullary tissue. Six independent rats were included per group. Bars indicate arithmetic means, error bars sample SDs and points individual rats. Expression was normalized within each rat to β-actin and calibrated to the sham arithmetic mean. Brackets compare model with sham or restoration. Tests used ΔCq with one Holm adjustment across all 18 original-panel comparisons. Displayed P values are Holm-adjusted across these 18 comparisons. Sham and model rats were sampled on day 28 and restoration rats on day 56. Full results are in Supplementary File 4. Sham, sham-operated; Rest., restoration. Codex assisted with conventional plotting code.
